query_payload.rationale: Add radius-scaled packing, local chemical order, angular geometry and charge-transfer proxies; sample rare elements, pnictides and complex oxides.
Add radius-scaled geometry, packing and local bond chemistry; sample pnictides, nonoxide light-element networks and underrepresented rare-element chemistries.
Add local bonding, charge-transfer, packing and invariant shell geometry beyond Magpie; broaden hydride/nitride, scarce heavy-element and oxygen-free pnictide coverage.
Retain compression/electron density; add coordination, bond polarity, molecular contacts and angular geometry. Sample nitrides, oxygen-free pnictides and sparse heavy metals.
Retain short-bond signals; add packing, coordination, local polarity and angular descriptors. Target nitrogen, pnictides and H/P/Re chemistries for additional labels.
Retain short-bond signals; add packing, normalized coordination, angular and charge-transfer descriptors. Sample nitrogen, pnictide and complex heavy-element chemistries.
